title: "BLL Survey Status"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  word_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# load packages
pacman::p_load(here,      # specify file directory
               rio,       # import/export data
               janitor,   # clean column names
               flextable,
               tidyverse  # data cleaning and manipulation
)


# read dataset
df_raw <- import(here("data.csv")) %>% 
  #remove_empty() %>%    # remove blank rows and columns
  distinct()    %>%         # remove any duplicate rows  
  clean_names() %>%          # standardize column names
  drop_na(id_child) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.character, ~na_if(., ''))

```

### Count by block
```{r}
df_status <- df_raw %>% 
  select(block, district, bll_child_cat, bll_child)  %>% 
 
  # replace BDL values with 2.3
  # replace high (category 3) values with 65
  
  mutate(bll_child_num = case_when(
  bll_child_cat == 2 ~ 2.3,   # substitute for BDL
  bll_child_cat == 3 ~ 65,    # substitute threshold for >65
  TRUE ~ bll_child
)) %>% 
  mutate(bll_5 = ifelse(bll_child_num >5, TRUE, FALSE),
         bll_10 = ifelse(bll_child_num >10, TRUE, FALSE),
         bll_20 = ifelse(bll_child_num >20, TRUE, FALSE),
         bll_45 = ifelse(bll_child_num >45, TRUE, FALSE),
         bdl = ifelse(bll_child_cat ==2, TRUE, FALSE),
         bll_high = ifelse(bll_child_cat ==3, TRUE, FALSE)) 

df_status %>% 
  tabyl(block) %>% 
  select(-percent) %>% 
  flextable()
```

### Count and BLL by district

```{r create-summary-function}
# Summary function
summarise_bll <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      min = min(bll_child_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(bll_child_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(bll_child_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      qntl_90 = round(quantile(bll_child_num, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      qntl_95 = round(quantile(bll_child_num, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      # pct5 = scales::percent(sum(bll_5, na.rm = TRUE) / n),
      # pct10 = scales::percent(sum(bll_10, na.rm = TRUE) / n),
      # pct20 = scales::percent(sum(bll_20, na.rm = TRUE) / n),
      # pct45 = scales::percent(sum(bll_45, na.rm = TRUE) / n),
      bdl = scales::percent(sum(bdl, na.rm = TRUE) / n),
      high_bll = scales::percent(sum(bll_high, na.rm = TRUE) / n)
    )
}
```

```{r create-summary-tables}

# Overall + district summaries
df_summary <- bind_rows(
  df_status %>%
    summarise_bll() %>%
    mutate(district = "Overall", .before = 1),

  df_status %>%
    group_by(district) %>%
    summarise_bll() %>%
    ungroup()
)

# Flextable
df_summary %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    district = "District",
    n = "N",
    min = "Minimum",
    max = "Maximum",
    median = "Median",
    qntl_90 = "90th percentile",
    qntl_95 = "95th percentile",
    bdl = "Pct BDL",
    high_bll = "Pct >65"
  ) %>%
  bold(i = 1, bold = TRUE, part = "body") %>%
  add_footer_lines(
    values = c(
      "Note:BDL = Below Detection Limit."
    )
  )
```

```{r bar-chart}
df_status %>%
  mutate(
    bll_group = case_when(
      bll_child_num < 5 ~ "<5",
      bll_child_num < 10 ~ "5–9",
      bll_child_num < 20 ~ "10–19",
      bll_child_num <= 45 ~ "20–45",
      bll_child_num > 45 ~ ">45"
    ),
    bll_group = factor(
      bll_group,
      levels = c("<5", "5–9", "10–19", "20–45", ">45")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(bll_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bll_group, y = pct, fill = bll_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1)),
            hjust = -0.5,
            size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format(),
                     limits = c(0, NA),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))+
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "<5" = "#436aef",
      "5–9" = "#f55858",
      "10–19" = "#f55858",
      "20–45" = "#f55858",
      ">45" = "#f55858"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Blood Lead Level (µg/dL)",
    y = "Percentage of children",
    title = "Distribution of Blood Lead Levels (BLL) Among Children",
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  ) +

  coord_flip() 

ggsave(here("bll_bar_chart.png"))
```
